projects.title: Ebony Forest Endemic Restoration
projects.description: Ebony Forest works to restore Mauritius' endemic forest in Chamarel by controlling invasive plants, propagating native species, and planting endemic plants. Publicly sourced photos are illustrative and are not submitted community audit evidence.

public_evidence.title: Conservation and Eco-Tourism Project: Environmental Impact Assessment, Chapter 4
public_evidence.publisher: Ministry of Environment, Solid Waste Management and Climate Change, Mauritius (host); project report
public_evidence.verification_method: Read the report sections describing site restoration and period totals; no plot georeferencing was available.
public_evidence.claim: Reports restoration methods, 144,445 m² first-time weeding (Aug 2006–May 2012), and 83,574 trees and shrubs planted (Nov 2006–Nov 2012).
public_evidence.limitations: Promoter/project EIA hosted on a government site; historical aggregate totals, not an independent audit of the dashboard polygon.
public_evidence.license: Source document; link to original; reuse subject to publisher terms

public_evidence.title: Restoring Native Forest at Chamarel — Final Report (Grant 65743)
public_evidence.publisher: Critical Ecosystem Partnership Fund (CEPF); report by Ebony Forest Ltd
public_evidence.verification_method: Checked grantee, project period, Chamarel site name, and reported aggregate planting/weeding totals.
public_evidence.claim: Reports 16 ha weeded and more than 20,000 native plants planted at the project landscape, with annual planting totals.
public_evidence.coordinate_precision: Project site; no activity plot coordinates
public_evidence.limitations: Grantee-authored final report hosted by funder; aggregate project totals do not identify the dashboard polygon.
public_evidence.license: Source document; link to original; reuse subject to publisher terms

public_evidence.title: Final Completion and Impact Report (Project 2671)
public_evidence.publisher: Critical Ecosystem Partnership Fund (CEPF); report by Ebony Forest Ltd
public_evidence.verification_method: Checked report metadata and restoration totals; treated the landscape coordinate as a representative site point, not an intervention location.
public_evidence.claim: Reports 7.56 ha first-weeded, 29.4 ha maintenance-weeded, and 10,026 native plants planted at Ebony Forest.
public_evidence.coordinate_precision: Published as a representative production-landscape coordinate, not an intervention/plot coordinate
public_evidence.limitations: Grantee report with site-level totals. The representative point is not a planting location and does not verify work inside the dashboard polygon.
public_evidence.license: Source document; link to original; reuse subject to publisher terms

public_evidence.title: Mauritian Wildlife Foundation Annual Report 2011–2012
public_evidence.verification_method: Checked the Ebony Forest/Chamarel report passage for native plant surveys and monitoring; no plot coordinates reported.
public_evidence.claim: Mentions restoration at Ebony Forest, a native plant survey, and regular monitoring of rare native plants.
public_evidence.limitations: Historical site-level monitoring summary; does not document current monitoring or the dashboard polygon.
public_evidence.license: Source document; link to original; reuse subject to publisher terms

public_evidence.title: Ebony Forest Reserve observations
public_evidence.activity_period: Observations reported from 2021 onward; inspect individual records
public_evidence.verification_method: Reviewed the public account index only; individual observation records were not validated for coordinates, uncertainty, date, or license.
public_evidence.claim: Public index of naturalist observations associated with the organization; individual record dates, coordinates, uncertainty, and licenses must be checked before use.
public_evidence.coordinate_precision: Varies per observation; not validated as a set against the project polygon
public_evidence.limitations: Candidate biodiversity observations only; an observation does not establish planting or maintenance. Do not count as plot verification until the individual record is checked.
public_evidence.license: Varies by observation; check each record's license before reusing media

public_evidence.title: Assessing the risks of changing ongoing management of endangered species
public_evidence.verification_method: Reviewed article metadata and abstract; classified it as bird-management context, not tree-restoration evidence.
public_evidence.claim: Studies management and population outcomes for the Mauritius olive white-eye; relevant to fauna management context, not tree planting milestones.
public_evidence.site_name: Mauritius; includes Ebony Forest Reserve Chamarel context
public_evidence.limitations: Not evidence of site preparation, tree planting, or vegetation maintenance on the dashboard polygon.
public_evidence.license: Publisher article; link to source; reuse subject to publisher terms
